Name: AdvancedFishingTreasure
Author: aceynk
Description:
This mod allows for customization of the fishing treasure chest in Stardew Valley. Some features include:

[list]
[*]Set the chance of getting a treasure chest.
[*]Set the amount of vanilla loot-table items to receive.
[*]Set a max/minimum price for all items in the treasure chest.
[*]Blacklist certain items from the vanilla and modded loot-tables.
[*]Add new items to the loot pool by category, and customize their chance.
[*]Contains an optional blacklist of possible bugged loot items.
[*]Add a coin reward for fishing up treasure chests.
[*]Allow vanilla fluctuation (magnet bait, treasure hunter tackle, luck, etc.) to influence treasure chest chance.
[*]Allow certain item qualities within treasure chests.
[*]Add items by context tag to the loot pool. (see: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Items#Context_tags]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Items#Context_tags[/url]﻿)
[/list]
This mod is meant to allow customization of the loot tables for the fishing treasure chests in the game. You can add entire new categories of items to the loot table, which could make fishing more interesting. You also get to customize the chance of spawning treasure chests.

Requires GMCM ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098[/url]﻿) for mod configuration.

This mod is open source, you can find the repository here: [url=https://github.com/aceynk/AdvancedFishingTreasure/tree/master]https://github.com/aceynk/AdvancedFishingTreasure/tree/master[/url]
